content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can deploy a complete commerce stack that handles hosting, payments, and product delivery. Start with GitHub Pages for storefront hosting—free and globally distributed. Use Google Apps Script for backend logic—no server management required. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing—300+ currencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. Store orders in Google Sheets—simple and reliable. Deliver files via Google Drive—instant and secure. This stack is live in hours, not days. You own every component. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. By the end of the day, you will have a fully operational store that accepts payments from anyone, anywhere. This is not a temporary solution. It is a permanent infrastructure shift. You are not renting—you are building.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack is designed for speed and sovereignty. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront—static, fast, free. Google Apps Script handles order processing—lightweight, serverless. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments—automatic webhooks trigger delivery. Google Sheets logs orders—no database required. Google Drive delivers files—instant, secure, scalable. This stack is not minimal in capability—it is maximal in control. You do not need a complex backend or expensive hosting. You do not need to wait for approvals or integrations. Every component is free or low-cost. Every component is under your control. This stack is pressure-tested in regions with actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. It works because it is built for the conditions you face. Deploy it today. Own it tomorrow.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Do not waste time on features you do not need. Skip custom domains—use GitHub Pages’ default URL. Skip email marketing—focus on direct sales. Skip analytics dashboards—use Google Sheets for order tracking. Skip complex design—use a simple, functional storefront. The goal is to get live, not to get perfect. Perfection is a delay tactic. Your audience needs to buy your products now. Your infrastructure needs to work now. Every additional feature is a potential point of failure. Every additional tool is a potential dependency. Start with what is essential. Add what is necessary later. Speed is the point. Control is the goal.
Deploy a sovereign commerce stack today—no geographic barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, deploy the storefront to GitHub Pages. Connect NOWPayments to your crypto wallet—choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. Test the payment flow with a small transaction. Verify that the webhook triggers file delivery from Google Drive. Confirm that the order is logged in Google Sheets. This process takes less than an hour. Once live, share your store link with your audience. Accept payments in any cryptocurrency. Deliver products instantly. Your first transaction proves the stack works. Your second transaction proves it scales. This is not a test—it is your new infrastructure. Use it. Rely on it. Build on it.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on three tasks. First, load your top three products into the stack. Second, test every component end-to-end. Third, share your store link with your audience. Do not wait for perfect. Do not wait for more features. Your audience needs to buy your products now. Your infrastructure needs to work now. After deployment, monitor transactions in Google Sheets. Optimize file delivery from Google Drive. Scale the stack as needed. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates—instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This is not a temporary fix. It is a permanent shift. You are not renting—you are building. You are not waiting—you are deploying.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I have no technical skills?

Yes. The stack is designed for simplicity. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script require no server management. NOWPayments integrates with a few clicks. Google Sheets and Drive are tools you already know. The Complete Builder Kit provides step-by-step guides and templates.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. Automatic webhooks trigger delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain.
Do I need to pay for hosting or servers?

No. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. Google Apps Script handles backend logic without servers. Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive delivers files. The entire stack is free or low-cost. You own every component.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The stack is designed for scalability. Cloudflare infrastructure can handle high traffic. Supabase can replace Google Sheets for larger order volumes. Cloudflare R2 can replace Google Drive for higher file delivery demands. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, your storefront remains live. Orders are stored in Google Sheets. Files are delivered from Google Drive. You retain full control. No single point of failure. No platform dependency.
Own your infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no dependencies.
